name: math master
content:
Compete for the highest score on this map.
Math skills required.

name: DD-rank (Knight of Night)
content:
Get the lowest miss count on this map.
The fewer misses, the better.
note: Số miss càng ít càng tốt.

name: PFC map combo cao nhất có thể
content:
Get a perfect full combo on this map.
Highest total score wins.
note: Phải FC. Tổng score cao nhất thắng.

name: Spin to Win
content:
Compete for the highest score on this map.
Spinners are key.

name: Jack of All Trades
content:
Set 4 consecutive plays (fails excluded), 1 per mode on the same beatmap difficulty, and minimize the quantity (stdev score)/(average score).
(Basically, try to get as close to having the same score over the four plays as possible)
note: Ranked/Approved maps only, stable only, and any mods except for NF are permitted.
